facts.text: Scope is the high-level handle to one ISDS205B; the class docstring says it is not thread-safe
CaptureResult carries ch1 and ch2 sample arrays, the sample rate, requested and actual lengths in KB, elapsed time, out-of-range flags and a timestamp
capture() raises ScopeError when Capture() returns zero or less or when IsDataReady times out, and the returned CaptureResult reports the actual capture length in KB
set_channel_range takes channel 0 for CH1 and 1 for CH2 and a min/max range in mV
The module docstring says SetOscChannelRange silently clamps to the widest internal gain step and get_voltage_resolution should be read after a range request
The live support list of this unit has five discrete sample rates: 1000000, 4000000, 8000000, 16000000 and 48000000 Hz
set_sample_rate returns the applied rate and raises ScopeError when the device returns 0
get_sample_rate reads the rate the device reports
This unit has no hardware trigger: IsSupportHardTrigger returned 0 in the live test
The trigger modes are AUTO=0 and CONTINUOUS=1

Trigger styles are the bitmask values NONE=0x0000, RISE_EDGE=0x0001, FALL_EDGE=0x0002, EDGE=0x0004, POS_PULSE_MORE=0x0008, POS_PULSE_LESS=0x0010, POS_PULSE=0x0020, NEG_PULSE_MORE=0x0040, NEG_PULSE_LESS=0x0080 and NEG_PULSE=0x0100
Trigger source 0 selects CH1 and 1 selects CH2; the trigger level is in mV
The pre-trigger percent range is 5 to 95 percent
AC coupling is a documented no-op on this unit; GetAcDc always reads back DC
The DDS waveform styles are SINE=0x00, SQUARE=0x01, TRIANGULAR=0x02, UP_SAWTOOTH=0x03 and DOWN_SAWTOOTH=0x04
DDS style-select and output-enable were confirmed on this unit; frequency and duty-cycle accuracy is unverified and the DLL has no Get counterpart
generator_enable writes DDSOutputEnable and is_generator_enabled reads IsDDSOutputEnable
set_generator applies the waveform style, frequency and duty cycle to the DDS
has_hard_trigger, has_dds, has_io, has_roll_mode and has_pretrigger_percent return the device support flags
memory_length_kb returns the capture memory depth in KB
The clone says grounding between CH1, CH2 and USB is not confirmed isolated and the GUI defaults to a conservative +/-5 V range
DDS amplitude and offset software trim is not supported on this unit
